pages.title: Anything Goes: Stickman Brawl
pages.creator: Rigelware Games
pages.description: Pick a fighter in Anything Goes: Stickman Brawl, from Javier the boxer to Dandara the capoeira fighter. Chain attacks into combos, use special moves, and grab objects such as chairs or bats when a fight gets crowded. Watch for trains, traffic, and lava across 15 stages. Play through Story, try Arena or Tower, or share one keyboard with a friend.

pages.title: Relaxing cubes and campfire
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Fit blocks into the grid in Relaxing cubes and campfire. A completed row or column disappears, opening space for the next pieces. Look for placements that leave room for larger shapes and listen to the campfire as you work on clearing lines.

pages.title: Fruit Catcher
pages.creator: abdeljalilhaddo
pages.description: Slide a basket from side to side in Fruit Catcher to collect fresh fruit as it falls. Leave the rotten pieces alone and look at what is coming down before choosing where to move. Each fresh catch adds to your score.

pages.title: Pinball VS Zombie
pages.creator: Big Wave
pages.description: Set up plant defenses in Pinball VS Zombie, then use bouncing pinballs to put them to work. When a ball strikes a plant, it triggers gunfire against the incoming zombies. Sunlight is collected automatically and helps you strengthen the defenses. Keep arranging plants and bouncing balls to stop the waves before they reach the house.

pages.title: Matrix Typer
pages.creator: Cassino.dev
pages.description: Type the words on screen in Matrix Typer to defend yourself inside a digital system. Work quickly enough to get through incoming code and watch your spelling, since mistakes leave you open to attacks. Keep typing accurately as the next threats arrive.

pages.title: Match Factory
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Collect identical objects in groups of three in Match Factory. Look through the pile for items you can reach and use each finished set to clear space for more. Layouts change from level to level, and power-ups can help when the item you need is difficult to reach.

pages.title: Find & Restore: Hidden Puzzle
pages.creator: Kovalenko Lesia Ivanivna
pages.description: Restore scrambled pictures in Find & Restore: Hidden Puzzle. Search each scene for a detail that has ended up in the wrong spot, then drag the piece back where it belongs. Use the shapes and colors around the gap to check your placement as the picture comes back together.

pages.title: FNF Unblocked​ Italian Brainrot
pages.creator: Online Games
pages.description: Hit the arrow keys in time with the music in FNF Unblocked​ Italian Brainrot. Face meme-inspired opponents including Sponge, Mustard, and Sprunki across songs with different rhythms and styles. Watch the note cues closely when the track changes pace or takes a turn toward horror.

pages.title: Italian Brainrot Survive Parkour
pages.creator: gameVgames
pages.description: Choose a meme character and run through obstacle courses in Italian Brainrot Survive Parkour. Watch what comes next on the track and time your jumps to get around the hazards. Adjust your movement when a new stage changes the route or the timing you need.

pages.title: Nonogram Daily
pages.creator: Denda Games
pages.description: Reveal a picture one square at a time in Nonogram Daily. Use the numbers beside the rows and columns to work out which cells to fill and which to leave empty. Compare the two sets of clues when a line is ambiguous, then return for a new puzzle the next day.

pages.title: Car Care Repair DuDu Mechanic
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Take on repair jobs in Car Care Repair DuDu Mechanic. Check each customer's car to see what needs fixing, from flat tires and broken windows to damaged doors or a faulty motor. Work through the tasks and replace missing parts to get the car ready for its owner.

pages.title: Split Shot: Ball Adventure
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Drag to set the ball's direction in Split Shot: Ball Adventure. Send it through a space-themed field to collect stars, taking care to steer clear of the spikes. Read the layout before you move so you can plan which stars to reach first.

pages.title: Bubble Shooter Blast
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Aim bubbles at matching colors in Bubble Shooter Blast. Make groups of at least three so they burst and open more of the board. Look for a clear angle before each shot, and work through more than 200 levels as the layouts get harder.

pages.title: Mr Bullet: Stealth Ninja Killstreak
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Carry out secret missions as an agent in Mr Bullet: Stealth Ninja Killstreak. Fight stickmen from a third-person view and use the destructible surroundings during shootouts and road chases. Some missions put you up against bigger threats such as tanks, helicopters, or mutant bosses.

pages.title: Real Motorbike Simulator Race 3D
pages.creator: Best Free Games
pages.description: Pick a motorcycle in Real Motorbike Simulator Race 3D and try tricks and stunts. Use each run to get a feel for how the bike handles before taking on a harder maneuver. Try different bikes and aim to earn prizes for your riding.

pages.title: Girls Fun Nail Salon
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description: Run a manicure appointment in Girls Fun Nail Salon. Cut and polish a customer's nails, then choose a design that suits the look she wants. Check the score she gives you and use it to see how well the finished nail art fit the appointment.

pages.title: Muki Wizard
pages.creator: MukiGames
pages.description: Fight through maps of enemies and bosses in Muki Wizard. Collect money and choose skills that help with the next fight. Try weapons with different firing speeds and suits that change your stats as the seasons get harder.

pages.title: Stickman Leave Prison
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Guide two stick figures out of prison in Stickman Leave Prison. Find the colored key that opens each character's door and watch for guards and hazards along the way. Collect money during the escape to unlock new skins.

pages.title: Knife Up 3D
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Time your throws in Knife Up 3D so the knives land without hitting the ball. Watch the movement before each throw and keep your timing steady as you compete with opponents. Clear levels to earn rewards you can put toward new skins.

pages.title: Vehicle Fun Race
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Guide a stick figure across land and water in Vehicle Fun Race. Run or swim through a section on your own, or pick up a motorcycle, car, or boat when one is available. Look for helicopters on the final platforms as you race the other runners to the finish.

pages.title: 2048 X2 Legends
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Shoot numbered blocks at matching values in 2048 X2 Legends to combine them into larger numbers. Work toward 2048 and see how far you can go before the board runs out of space. Use a booster when you need help making room for another shot.

pages.title: TPS Gun War Shooting Games 3D
pages.creator: Driving games
pages.description: Take on shooting missions in TPS Gun War Shooting Games 3D. Fight enemies and zombies with weapons that include sniper rifles, machine guns, and grenades. Change weapons when the fight calls for a different approach and make time to reload before you move in.

pages.title: Jetpack Rush Simulator 3D
pages.creator: SadaatGames
pages.description: Run through obstacle courses in Jetpack Rush Simulator 3D. Press Space to jump, or hold it to get a boost from the jetpack. Look at how far away the next hurdle is before you decide whether a short jump will carry you past it.

pages.title: Speed Demons Race
pages.creator: Itmium Limited
pages.description: Build and race a monster truck in Speed Demons Race. Take on hills, metal jumps, and obstacles such as containers and wooden boxes. Use the throttle and brake to adjust the truck's angle in the air. Earn coins from wins and tricks to improve the truck for the next race.

pages.title: Cameraman vs Skibidi Toilet
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Aim at toilets standing on different platforms in Cameraman vs Skibidi Toilet. Set up each shot with the mouse or touch controls and take out the targets to clear the level. Check how high or far away the next target is before you fire.

pages.title: Celebrity Easter Fashionista
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Style celebrities for an Easter gathering in Celebrity Easter Fashionista. Browse the wardrobe and choose an outfit for each guest. Give them different looks for the occasion or pick pieces that work together when the group gets together to celebrate.

pages.title: Pyramid Solitaire Blue
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: Clear the pyramid in Pyramid Solitaire Blue by pairing exposed cards whose values add up to 13. Kings can be removed on their own. Look at what each pair uncovers before you choose it, since a card you reveal now might help you clear a different row later.

pages.title: Roller Coaster
pages.creator: 2Play
pages.description: Guide a train around loops in Roller Coaster. Pick up more passengers as you ride and steer around the hazards before they interrupt the trip. Work through levels with different track layouts and keep track of what is coming up as the train gathers speed.

pages.title: Harmony Tester
pages.creator: crazyschoolgames
pages.description: Compare zodiac signs in Harmony Tester and see the compatibility reading for you and a partner. The game also offers horoscope interpretations to read on their own. Try another sign pairing if you want to see how its reading differs.

pages.title: Tractor Coloring Pages
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Pick one of twelve tractor pictures in Tractor Coloring Pages. Choose paint from the palette and change the brush size when you move from a broad area to a small detail. Use the eraser to correct a mistake and save the picture when you finish.

pages.title: Brain Games
pages.creator: trezegames
pages.description: Work through six activities in Brain Games. The sequence switches between challenges involving memory, attention, arithmetic, logic, and coordination. Focus on what each activity asks you to do before moving on, since a skill that helps in one round may differ from what you need in the next.

pages.title: Brave Baby Escape
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Play as one of the Calabash Brothers in Brave Baby Escape and set out to rescue your foster grandfather. Guide the character through the dangers inspired by the story of the Scorpion and Snake spirits. Keep moving toward Grandpa while looking for a way through each area.

pages.title: Bike Mania 4 Micro Office
pages.creator: AceViral.com LTD
pages.description: Ride a miniature motorcycle across office obstacles in Bike Mania 4 Micro Office. Use the arrows or touch controls to move and lean the rider. Shift your balance before climbing onto an object, then straighten up as you drop off the other side.

pages.title: Counter Craft
pages.creator: G55.CO
pages.description: Fight other players on block-built maps in Counter Craft. Buy weapons and use them to take on rivals in multiplayer battles. Learn where the routes through each map meet so you can find firing positions and watch for players approaching from another direction.

pages.title: Russian Battle Royale
pages.creator: G55.CO
pages.description: Search a Russian city for weapons in Russian Battle Royale. Move through the neighborhood and fight the hostile gopniks you encounter. Switch weapons with the mouse wheel when you find something better suited to the fight, and reload when you have room.

pages.title: Icy Purple Head. Super Slide
pages.creator: Miniduck
pages.description: Switch between icy and purple forms in Icy Purple Head. Super Slide. The icy form slides along surfaces while the purple form sticks, so time each change to control when you move or stop. Use the two states to get through the winter tracks and reach every checkpoint.

pages.title: Survive Alone
pages.creator: Codecrust
pages.description: Stay alive on an island in Survive Alone. Craft supplies, grow food, hunt, and light a fire as you deal with wild animals and harsh weather. Check your inventory and keep track of your hunger, thirst, and mood as you prepare for another day.

pages.title: Ice Princess Beauty Surgery
pages.creator: babygames.com
pages.description: Help Elsa get ready for a beauty pageant in Ice Princess Beauty Surgery. Work through the game's cosmetic treatment steps, then choose makeup and an outfit for the contest. Move from one part of the preparation to the next until Elsa is ready to join Anna.

pages.title: Funny Rescue Gardener
pages.creator: iclickgames
pages.description: Help Samantha recover after a gardening accident in Funny Rescue Gardener. Choose the tools the game gives you and use them to tend to her injuries. Follow the treatment steps as each problem is shown and help her get back on her feet.

pages.title: Army Vehicles And Aircraft Memory
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Flip cards to find matching military vehicles and aircraft in Army Vehicles And Aircraft Memory. Remember where you saw a picture when the first two cards do not match. Clear all the pairs across four levels and try to use fewer turns on a replay.

pages.title: Monster Truck Stunts
pages.creator: Online Games io
pages.description: Choose a truck and take it over the course in Monster Truck Stunts. Accelerate or brake with W and S, and use A and D to adjust the truck's pitch in the air. Collect the coins as you go and aim for a landing that lets you keep driving.

pages.title: Wall fixing
pages.creator: TechionicsInc
pages.description: Fit the moving block into the empty space in Wall fixing. Use the arrow keys to steer it and compare its position with the gap. Keep lining up the block as the wall approaches so it can pass through the opening.

pages.title: BTS LoL Coloring Book
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Pick a doll picture and give it your own colors in BTS LoL Coloring Book. Use the mouse or tap to work on the drawing, then switch colors for another part of the doll. Choose a different picture when you want to try a new design.

pages.title: Kingdom Defence: Mercenary
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Protect the kingdom from monsters in Kingdom Defence: Mercenary. Choose defenses and weapons that can stop the attackers before they reach the castle. Scroll the map with the arrow keys to see where the waves are coming from and adjust your strategy.

pages.title: Cartoon Police Car Slide
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Put together three police car pictures in Cartoon Police Car Slide. Choose an image and a puzzle mode, then slide the shuffled pieces into place. Follow details such as the roof lights or wheels to see where two tiles should meet.

pages.title: Amazing Squares
pages.creator: Amazing Games Network
pages.description: Fit colorful pieces together in Amazing Squares. Look at the shape of the open space before choosing a placement, and watch which gaps you leave for later blocks. Check your in-game statistics and rankings as you work toward achievements.

pages.title: Road Garbage Dump Truck Cleaner
pages.creator: hitNrun games
pages.description: Drive a garbage truck in Road Garbage Dump Truck Cleaner and take on cleanup jobs around the city and highways. Use the vehicle suited to the task and work through each route as it is assigned. Keep the truck under control while moving between parts of the cleanup.

pages.title: Santa Racer
pages.creator: sienar games
pages.description: Race for first place in Santa Racer. Take on the computer or share the game with a friend using separate keys. Watch the next turn and keep the car on a line that lets you maintain speed as you head for the finish.

pages.title: Loetanks
pages.creator: Loebyte
pages.description: Take turns moving and firing in Loetanks. Choose a spot inside the movement circle to reposition the tank, then pull back and aim a shot at your opponent. Account for the wind before releasing it, and try the different classes in solo or multiplayer matches.

pages.title: Adventure Of Green Kid
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Jump between platforms in Adventure Of Green Kid. Collect diamonds along the way and look out for spikes, swinging axes, and monsters. Time each jump for a clear landing and keep working toward the end of the level.

pages.title: Toy Box Bomb
pages.creator: Good Funny Game
pages.description: Tap matching boxes in Toy Box Bomb to make a group burst. Look for at least two that can go together and choose a clear that leaves more useful groups on the board. See what changes after the blast before choosing the next set.

pages.title: Fantastic Shooter
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Line up shots in Fantastic Shooter to solve a series of 60 shooting puzzles. Look at how the targets are positioned before you click to fire. Adjust the shot as the layouts change and work out the angle that can clear each stage.

pages.title: A2Z Connect
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Drag through adjacent copies of a letter in A2Z Connect. Link at least three across rows, columns, or diagonals, then release to merge them into a higher letter. Build up to Z and try Normal or Hard when you want each upgrade to take more work.

pages.title: Happy Halloween Slide
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Slide the tiles to rebuild Halloween scenes in Happy Halloween Slide. Pick one of three pictures and a puzzle mode before you start. Check the details along the tile edges to work out which pieces should be next to each other.

pages.title: Police Car Parking
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Park a police vehicle after its shift in Police Car Parking. Steer through the parking area and give yourself room to straighten the car before pulling into the designated space. Judge the turn into the bay as well as where you stop.

pages.title: Planet Zombie
pages.creator: Ixel Games
pages.description: Use a sniper rifle to stop walkers in Planet Zombie before they reach the city. Aim carefully and fire when you have the zombie in your sights. Watch which targets are closest to town as the horde approaches.

pages.title: Oil Tanker Transport Driving Simulation Game
pages.creator: zuma studio
pages.description: Take an oil tanker off-road in Oil Tanker Transport Driving Simulation Game. Pick up the cargo for each mission and bring it to the destination before time expires. Keep the tanker steady through rough stretches while leaving enough time to make the delivery.

pages.title: Battle of Tanks
pages.creator: BeedoGames
pages.description: Send groups of tanks toward the enemy base in Battle of Tanks. Deploy at least three vehicles to push forward, and decide which types will work best together. Watch the battle in real time and time your next deployment for when it can help the attack.

pages.title: City Live Bus Simulator 2019
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames
pages.description: Pick up passengers at bus stops and take them to their destinations in City Live Bus Simulator 2019. Steer around other vehicles and watch for pedestrians while driving the route. A collision can end the mission, so make room before pulling in or turning.

pages.title: Snow Hill Racing
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Race through snowy terrain in Snow Hill Racing. Keep the car under control as the course climbs and turns, and look at what is coming before you build up speed. Try another run to get more comfortable with the layout.

pages.title: Squad Rifles
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Command a squad in Squad Rifles and deploy soldiers with different specialties. Pick the units that suit the current fight and send them forward to take control of the front line. Watch how the enemy responds before committing the next group.

pages.title: Tug the Table
pages.creator: Royale Gamers
pages.description: Pull your opponent across the center line in Tug the Table. Time your tugs and keep going when the other side starts to pull back. Play a single-player match or challenge a friend, and build your score by winning rounds.

pages.title: Gems
pages.creator: Intersoft Ltd
pages.description: Use the arrow keys to slide gems around the board in Gems. Bring equal gems together to merge them and check what the move leaves behind. Plan where the next pair can meet so you can keep combining pieces as the layout changes.

pages.title: Pet Crush
pages.creator: Yizhiyuan Network Technology Co., Ltd.
pages.description: Make match-three sets of animals in Pet Crush. Collect pieces showing pigs, frogs, rabbits, and bears by lining up matching tiles. Watch which animals the board gives you and use boosters to help reach pieces that are harder to clear.

pages.title: Cube The Runners
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Send a cube jumping over traps and gaps in Cube The Runners. Pick one of four courses with different difficulty levels, then watch what is ahead so you can time each leap. Use the touch controls or the K and F keys to play.

pages.title: Helix Jump Piano
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Turn the piano tower in Helix Jump Piano to send a bouncing note down through gaps in the loops. Use a swipe, the mouse, or the keyboard to line up an opening beneath it. Keep the note falling as the challenge continues.

pages.title: Slenderclown: Be Afraid Of IT!
pages.creator: danygames.com
pages.description: Search an abandoned carnival and an abandoned building in Slenderclown: Be Afraid Of IT! Collect the colored balloons while looking out for Slender Clown and the creatures he has summoned. Use the available weapons to fight the clowns as you work through the two missions.

pages.title: Dragon World
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Fly over mountains as a dragon in Dragon World. Decide whether to fight other dragons or make allies while exploring the landscape. Use the space above the terrain to approach another dragon or change course when you need room.

pages.title: Candy Star
pages.creator: BestGames
pages.description: Line up at least three identical sweets in Candy Star to clear them and score. Look for matches that help finish the current challenge, then see how quickly you can complete the board. The game offers hundreds of levels to work through.

pages.title: Don't Drop The White Ball
pages.creator: T
pages.description: Keep a bouncing ball from falling in Don't Drop The White Ball. Tap to change direction and line up with the platform before the ball comes back down. Watch where it is headed and time each adjustment as you try to improve your score.

pages.title: Traffic Speed Racer
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Drive through traffic in Traffic Speed Racer and click the road to change lanes. Watch for both moving vehicles and fixed roadblocks before moving over. Find a gap through the next stretch and reach the destination to finish the level.

pages.title: Boxing Superstars KO Champion
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Fight four professional opponents in Boxing Superstars KO Champion. Use jabs, crosses, and uppercuts when you have an opening, and dodge when the other boxer starts a strike. Read the timing of each opponent as the fights get harder.

pages.title: Chroma
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: In Chroma, change the colors on the board until the whole layout shares one color. Pick a color that joins your current area to neighboring pieces, then look at what the larger region touches. Plan the next change around what it can bring into the group.

pages.title: Right Left Up Down Reverse
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Read the pattern on each arrow in Right Left Up Down Reverse before you swipe. Swipe with a solid arrow and against a dotted one. The direction on the screen is only half of the prompt, so check the arrow style before making the move.

pages.title: Connect The Dots
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Link dots of the same color in Connect The Dots. Each stage asks you to collect a minimum number before the moves run out. Look for longer connections that help reach the target, and try the abilities introduced as the boards get trickier.

pages.title: Animal Shapes 2
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Make pictures of domestic animals in Animal Shapes 2. Compare each geometric piece with the space it needs to fill, then bring the parts together into a complete animal. Look at the edges and corners to tell apart shapes that look similar.

pages.title: Glam Girl Busy Weekend
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Build looks for different occasions in Glam Girl Busy Weekend. Choose an outfit for a casual day, a party, or a vacation, then pick makeup and a hairstyle that fit. Change the pieces when the setting calls for another style.

pages.title: Foody Avenue
pages.creator: littlegiantworld
pages.description: Build a row of food businesses in Foody Avenue. Open places such as a bakery or a ramen shop, restock the stands, and upgrade them as sales grow. Hire specialists to unlock recipes and decide which part of the avenue to develop next.

pages.title: Couples Valentine's Day
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Help Barbie get ready for Valentine's Day in Couples Valentine's Day. Go to the mall with Rachel and Alex and look through the dresses for the occasion. Try different looks before deciding what Barbie should wear.

pages.title: Spirit of the Ancient Forest
pages.creator: Shaman Games Studio
pages.description: Help Sarah save the Great Tree in Spirit of the Ancient Forest. Search scenes for matching objects and select pairs before the timer expires. Some puzzles mix pairs with sets of three, so check how many copies are in view as Sarah makes her way toward the Dark Lord's Citadel.

pages.title: Ricochet
pages.creator: Saryn Studios
pages.description: Tap to keep the ball in the air in Ricochet and bounce it off the walls. Reach the required number of ricochets to unlock the next level. Watch for spikes and saw blades before sending the ball toward another bounce.

pages.title: The Floor is Lava!!!
pages.creator: GoalieGames
pages.description: Stay above the lava in The Floor is Lava!!! by jumping between safe surfaces. Look for the next place you can land before leaving the one you are on. Keep moving while you have room to choose a safe landing.

pages.title: Princess vs Monster Girl
pages.creator: Play Belle Games
pages.description: Style a frozen princess and a monster-school celebrity in Princess vs Monster Girl. Choose a look for each character and see how the outfits compare. Pick the one you want to support as the game decides who is best dressed.
